reasoning_traces.think:
The core duality lies between signal complexity \( C \) and team coordination \( \mathcal{C} \). As \( C \) increases, \( \mathcal{C} \) decreases due to information overload and misalignment. The entropy \( H \) of the signal system grows with \( C \), reflecting increased uncertainty in player interpretation. Collision frequency \( f_c \) rises with \( C \) because players act on ambiguous signals, leading to chaotic motion. When \( C \) is reduced through simplification, \( \mathcal{C} \) improves dramatically. The transformation from complex \( \mathcal{S} \) to simple \( \mathbb{Z}_4 \) plays is a symmetry-breaking event that restores coherence. Failure modes include: overfitting to \( C \), underestimating \( \mathcal{C} \), and assuming \( f_c \) is negligible. The model assumes deterministic behavior but allows stochastic variation in \( \mathcal{C} \).
